sample_unit: ChatGPT responses (5 questions x 5 otolaryngologic procedures)

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT clinical content on ENT procedures (risks, steps, recovery)
links.effect: Appropriate treatment alternatives in all procedures; lacked precision in procedural steps, missed key surgical details, did not provide all major risks; total laryngectomy recovery wrongly said patient could speak immediately.
links.quote: When queried for methodology, risks, and procedural steps, ChatGPT lacked precision in the description of procedural steps, missed key surgical details, and did not accurately provide all major risks of each procedure.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5 answering simulated patient questions about common otolaryngology surgical procedures.
